Rally · 5 Teves

Didan Notzach

Fifteen minutes of commanding, ready to run. The same five parts as the Yoma Depagra package, sequenced.

1

Niggun

YD Niggunim · 2 min

Open with the melody of the date. The platoon already knows it from the week it was featured.

2

The Twelve Pesukim

4 min

A soldier leads each posuk, one word at a time; the platoon repeats. A different soldier each posuk.

3

The Story

YD Comics · YD Stories · YD Timelines · 5 min

Read the comic aloud, or tell it from the timeline if you are short on time.

4

Activity

YD Game · 2 min

Spot the five differences. Two minutes, then answers.

5

The Mission

1 min

Announce it, then close.

“Your missions continue. Report to me.”
The Twelve Pesukim, in order
1
תּוֹרָה צִוָּה לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה
2
שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל
3
בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר
4
כִּי קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ
5
וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ
6
כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל יֵשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק
7
בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹקִים
8
וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ
9
יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו
10
וְזֶה שֶׁגָּרַם
11
יָגַעְתִּי וּמָצָאתִי תַּאֲמִין
12
בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַה׳

Content for this rally will fill from the Hachayol issue for that date. Order of the Twelve Pesukim to be confirmed against the official Tzivos Hashem card before print.
